release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD1017-2 is an indoor thermal presence detector with a narrower-FOV 1.9 mm lens, using a 160x120 thermal module to count people and detect presence without capturing identifiable video. It also performs fire-prevention temperature alarms and can drive a relay for lighting or HVAC control.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal-only stream.
